# fork-sync

> Keeps the curated Blockchains forks in line with their upstreams: forks.json lists each fork, upstream, branch and mode (merge via the merge-upstream API, or tracking for forks whose GitHub parent differs from the real upstream); nightly workflow + box-side script.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/fork-sync/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/fork-sync/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/fork-sync/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)

## Key files

- [forks.json](https://github.com/Blockchains/fork-sync/blob/main/forks.json): fork list
- [scripts/sync.py](https://github.com/Blockchains/fork-sync/blob/main/scripts/sync.py): sync script

## Related

- [Build with Blocks](https://github.com/Blockchains/.github/blob/main/docs/BUILD-WITH-BLOCKS.md): how to assemble projects from Blockchains repos
- [Org llms.txt](https://blockchains.github.io/llms.txt) · [blocks catalogue](https://blockchains.github.io/blocks.json)
- [Blockchains/blockchainlab-index](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-index): indexes the synced forks nightly, after this runs
- [Blockchains/awesome-blockchainlab](https://github.com/Blockchains/awesome-blockchainlab): list of the same forks
- [Blockchains/grokhack-index](https://github.com/Blockchains/grokhack-index): syncs its own fork list best-effort
